---
name: editorial-writing
description: Draft or revise essays and editorial articles for Independent Research while preserving the author's argument and source boundaries.
---

Read AGENTS.md. Establish the audience, central claim, and evidence from supplied context. Ask only for missing information that materially affects the piece. Keep private working drafts outside the public repository.

Use plain language, concrete examples, and a clear distinction between sourced facts and interpretation. Preserve the author's voice. Avoid inflated claims, generic introductions, and invented quotations or citations. Link to the original source for factual claims where appropriate, and flag claims still needing verification.

Provide a complete draft or focused revision. Explain substantive changes briefly. Only write approved public text into `src/content/publications/`; changing `published` to true requires approval of the actual article for release.
